judge_assessment.explanation: I agree with the REJECT and with its stated cause, which I verified precisely. scripts/score_eval_run.response_surfaces() accepts an artifact as surfaced only if the response contains the resolved filename, or contains a '.pdf'/'PDFs' token AND the role phrase. final_response.md for this case contains no filename and no occurrence of 'pdf' or 'PDF' at all - it opens 'Here are the three documents' and heads its sections 'Worksheet', 'Answer key', 'Study guide' - so all three roles fail together. Every other case in this shard writes at least a 'PDFs' token and most write actual filenames. The judge is also right that the mathematics is sound: 4(x+7) = 4x+28, 5(3x-2) = 15x-10, 7x+3+2x+8 = 9x+11, 8m+5-3m+2 = 5m+7, 3(x+4)+2x = 5x+12, 6x+15 = 3(2x+5), 4(2x+3)-3(x-2) = 5x+18, 12n-18 = 6(2n-3), 5(7+3)+4(7) = 78, 3(2x-5) = 6x-15. Where I part from the judge is answer_key_quality 4/4 and 'the worked key are correct'. The Quick Answers bank prints '6. 6x + 15' and '8. 12n - 18' - the UNFACTORED forms - on the two problems that ask for a factored product, while the worked key correctly boxes 3(2x + 5) and 6(2n - 3). I reproduced the cause: sympy.latex(sympy.sympify('3*(2*x + 5)')) returns '6 x + 15' because sympify distributes before latex runs. Separately, problem 10 requires a written explanation and verify.json declares no manual entry, a gap the packet's own final_response.md and answer key both admit in writing ('Note for the grader: the written explanation is judged by you'), and problem 9 prints its own answer line for the simplified 9x + 15 with no verify entry covering it.

strengths_to_preserve: Problems 6 and 8 present factoring as the area model run backwards, reusing the same picture the sheet used for distribution in problems 1 and 5, and the key states the connection outright ('Distributing back gives 6x + 15 - factoring is the area model run backwards'). Keep this forward/backward reuse of one representation.

Problem 10's key does not stop at the corrected expression: it tests both forms at x = 1 (the correct one gives -9, matching 3(2-5); Jamal's gives 1) which turns 'equivalent expressions' into something checkable rather than asserted. Problem 9 does the same at x = 7.
Problem 7 pairs a distribute-and-subtract table with the sign trap named explicitly in the key ('The trap is -3 x (-2): a negative times a negative is +6, so the constants grow rather than shrink').
Every stem states its units and givens - metres, minutes, markers, square inches, dollars - as the representations-and-applications prompt requires, with no irrelevant story detail.

root_causes.description: SKILL.md's Deliver step tells the agent to hand the three PDFs over but does not require the final response to identify them by filename, and no pre-answer check mirrors the scorer's response_surfaces() rule. A response that names the documents only by role passes every build gate and still fails delivery scoring on all three artifacts at once.
evidence: evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/final_response.md contains no filename and no '.pdf' or 'PDFs' token; it names the three documents only by role
scripts/score_eval_run.py response_surfaces() requires the filename, or a (?:\.pdf\b|\bpdfs?\b) match plus the role phrase
The official score records three hard failures, one per PDF role, and the judge's errors list says the PDFs exist in the packet but were not surfaced
All nine other cases in this shard contain at least a 'PDFs' token in final_response.md

root_causes.description: render_quick_answers._fmt renders a string expected as sympy.latex(sympy.sympify(value)); sympify evaluates a Number times an Add, so a declared factored answer is expanded before it is ever typeset. The bank therefore prints a different FORM than the worksheet asked for on precisely the problems where the form is the assessed skill.
evidence: evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/answer_key.pdf Quick Answers prints '6. 6x + 15' and '8. 12n - 18'; the worked solutions on the same document box 3(2x + 5) and 6(2n - 3)

root_causes.description: Items that require a written diagnosis or a drawn representation are recorded as machine verified because a numeric companion value exists, so the gate log reports zero manual items for a sheet full of open responses. The manual type exists and is used correctly on other cases in this same run, which shows the contract is author discretion rather than an enforced rule.
evidence: evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/worksheet.pdf problem 10: 'Say which number he failed to multiply and why the distributive property requires it'
evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/verify.json id 10 is a single expand entry; no manual entry exists and gate_log.txt reports '10 passed, 0 failed, 0 manual'

evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/answer_key.pdf problem 10 prints 'Note for the grader: the written explanation is judged by you - only the corrected expression is machine-verified', and final_response.md repeats the caveat, so the open response was recognised and still not declared

root_causes.description: The verify JSON is authored one entry per problem id rather than one entry per printed response, so a stem that asks for two things is recorded as fully machine verified when only its last component was checked. Nothing in the gate chain compares the number of answer locations the sheet prints against the number of entries covering them.
evidence: evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/worksheet.pdf problem 9 prints a separate Answer line for (a) 'Simplify the total cost expression' and another for (b) the value at x = 7
evals/runs/curriculum-shardX-20260802T194403Z/tasks/curr-173/verify.json id 9 is a single eval at x = 7 expecting 78; the simplified expression 9x + 15 that the key derives has no verify entry

improvements.title: Name every delivered PDF by filename in the final response
improvements.proposed_change: SKILL.md step 6 (Deliver) must require the final response to list all three artifacts by their actual filenames (ws_*.pdf, ak_*.pdf, ss_*.pdf) with page counts, not by role alone. Add a delivery self-check the agent runs before answering that mirrors score_eval_run.response_surfaces: for each of student_worksheet, step_by_step_answer_key and study_guide the response must contain the resolved filename, or a .pdf / PDFs token together with the role phrase.
improvements.regression_test: Add a test asserting that response_surfaces() reports all three roles unsurfaced for curr-173's final_response.md verbatim, and that the same text with the three filenames added reports all three surfaced. Then add the pre-answer delivery check to the skill's build path so the failing text can never be emitted; the check fails on today's text and passes once filenames are present.
improvements.expected_impact: Removes the failure mode where a complete, mathematically correct packet is rejected outright because the closing prose named the documents by role and never once wrote 'PDF' or a filename.
improvements.risk: None to the artifacts; the change touches the delivery prose and one pre-answer check. A harness that attaches files without visible names still needs the role-phrase fallback.

improvements.title: Preserve factored form when rendering a factor problem into the Quick Answers bank
improvements.proposed_change: sympy.sympify('3*(2*x + 5)') auto-distributes to 6*x + 15 before sympy.latex ever runs, so the bank prints the expanded form of an answer the worksheet asked to be factored. Parse string expecteds with parse_expr(..., evaluate=False), or format the declared string directly, so the printed structure is the structure the verify JSON declared, and add a post-check that a 'factor' problem's bank entry contains a parenthesised product.
improvements.regression_test: In tests/test_render_quick_answers.py, render a bank from {"id": 6, "type": "factor", "expr": "6*x + 15", "expected": "3*(2*x + 5)"} and assert the entry contains a parenthesised product ('3\left(2 x + 5\right)' or '3(2x + 5)') and does NOT equal '6 x + 15'. It fails today because sympify distributes, and passes once the non-evaluating parse is used.
improvements.expected_impact: A teacher grading from the bank stops marking a correctly factored answer wrong against an expanded one, on exactly the problems where factoring is the skill being assessed.
improvements.risk: Non-evaluating expressions print less canonically for ordinary answers, so restrict the non-evaluating path to problem types whose form is load-bearing (factor, equiv) and keep the evaluating path everywhere else.

improvements.title: Declare a manual verify entry for every explain, name-the-error, or draw-it item
improvements.proposed_change: Any problem whose stem asks the student to explain, justify, say why, name the error, describe, decide which student is right, or draw and label a representation must carry a 'manual' entry in verify.json alongside whatever numeric entries it also needs. Add a lint over the \problem stems in the worksheet tex that flags those constructions and fails the build when the matching problem id has no manual entry, so 'N passed, 0 manual' can only be printed by a sheet that genuinely contains no open response.
improvements.regression_test: Add a lint fixture from curr-173 problem 10 ('Say which number he failed to multiply and why ...') with a verify JSON declaring only an expand entry. The lint must exit non-zero; adding a manual entry must clear it.
improvements.expected_impact: The gate log's manual count becomes a truthful statement about the sheet, and the prompt's standing instruction to clearly label any genuinely open response for manual review is satisfied structurally instead of by author discretion.
improvements.risk: Verb matching will over-trigger on rhetorical asides such as 'show your thinking' in the directions block. Scope the scan to \problem stems and allow an explicit per-problem acknowledgement flag to suppress a false positive.

improvements.title: Verify every response the worksheet prints a slot for, not only the final numeric result
improvements.proposed_change: Require one verify-JSON entry (machine or manual) per distinct response the sheet asks the student to write, not one per problem id. That covers each lettered sub-part, the remainder half of a 'quotient with a remainder' answer, the person or option a stem asks the learner to name, and every intermediate form a stem explicitly requests before the final one. Enforce it with a gate that counts printed answer locations per problem in the worksheet tex (\ansline, \ansblank, \answerline, and (a)/(b)/(c) part markers inside a \problem stem) and fails the build when a problem's combined machine plus manual entries cover fewer slots than the sheet prints.
improvements.regression_test: Extend the slot gate fixture with curr-173 problem 9, whose tex emits two answer lines ((a) simplify, (b) evaluate) against a single eval entry. The gate must report one uncovered response until an equiv entry for 9x + 15 is added.
improvements.expected_impact: Every printed blank has a checked value behind it, so neither the Quick Answers bank nor a boxed key answer can be a partial answer to the question actually asked.
improvements.risk: Counting slots from tex is heuristic and a stem that prints '(a)' as ordinary prose could raise a false failure. Scope the counter to part markers at the start of a sentence and allow an explicit per-problem slot-count override in the verify JSON.

case_summary: A mathematically excellent expressions workshop rejected on delivery, and the rejection is correct: final_response.md names the three documents by role but contains no filename and never writes 'PDF', which is exactly what the scorer's surfacing rule requires, so all three artifact roles fail at once. Beyond the gate the judge stopped at, the answer key carries two further defects it scored 4/4: the Quick Answers bank prints the expanded forms 6x + 15 and 12n - 18 for the two problems that ask for a factored product, because sympify distributes before rendering; and problem 10's required written explanation is never declared manual even though the key and the final response both state in prose that it is teacher-judged. Problem 9's simplified expression is likewise a printed answer slot with no verify entry. The ten mathematical results and the area-model pedagogy are strong and should be preserved intact.
